name: Adam Hamawy

accounts.evidence: Dr. Adam Hamawy's NJ-12 campaign website links x.com/HamawyForNJ in its social links and embeds a video post from that account.

notes: Only the campaign account was found; no separate personal X account was linked. He is a representative-elect, so no official House account exists yet.

name: Teresa Benitez-Thompson
notes: Her campaign site electteresa.com links Facebook, Instagram (ElectTeresa) and TikTok (tbt_nv) but no X account. Wikipedia and the BOLD PAC candidate page list no X account, and Ballotpedia returned an empty page. Three searches found no handle. She may not have an active X account. No searches were refused.

name: Claire Valdez

accounts.evidence: The Claire Valdez for Congress (NY-7) campaign website links x.com/claireforny in its social links.

notes: No separate Assembly-office or personal X account was found. Her Bluesky and Facebook use 'claireforqueens', but no X account by that name was linked from any page I opened.

name: Brad Lander

accounts.evidence: Brad Lander's congressional campaign website links x.com/bradlander as his X account.

notes: This is his long-running personal account, now used for the campaign. The New York City Comptroller office account belongs to that office, not to him, so it was not included.

name: Micah Lasher

accounts.evidence: Micah Lasher's campaign website links twitter.com/micahlasher in its social links.

notes: News coverage also reports Rep. Jerry Nadler tagging @micahlasher in his endorsement post. No separate Assembly-office X account was found.

name: Darializa Avila Chevalier

accounts.evidence: Her campaign website links x.com/darializaforny in its social links.

notes: News coverage writes the handle as @DarializaforNY; X handles are not case-sensitive. An amNY article says her earlier personal account @darializabonet was deleted in 2022, so it was not included.
